title: African American Studies, Minor (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: 18cr exact bulletin match, fully clean. Prescribed AFAM 100N + AFAM 101N + AFAM 110N (9cr, all prereq-free). Bulletin requires 9cr of electives with at least 6cr at the 400 level; filled with AFAM 102 (300-and-below, 3cr, prereq-free) + AFAM 401 + AFAM 409 (both 400-level, prereq-free, 6cr). Entirely reuses afam_catalog.json, already built for the AFAM major -- no new scraping needed. Several bulletin-listed 400-level electives (AFAM 412, 463, 469) carry real prereqs (intro theatre/dance or first-year-writing courses) and were skipped in favor of the clean AFAM 401/409 pair, consistent with this session's pattern of preferring prereq-free picks when enough real alternatives exist.
